brief:
Wednesday marks the first anniversary of an Israeli airstrike that targeted the headquarters of Hamas's leadership delegation in Doha, according to Shehab Wire. The strike on the Qatari capital represented what regional observers characterized as a flagrant breach of national sovereignty and international law.

The operation, which took place a year ago, had aimed at senior Hamas officials stationed in the Gulf state. The raid sparked immediate diplomatic tensions, drawing responses from Qatar and other regional governments over the violation of their airspace and territory. No immediate details emerged regarding casualties or the extent of damage inflicted by the strike.
